record.context_brief: Orbifolds covered by compact symmetric spaces
record.original_question: Study the analogue of the compact-symmetric-space quotient problem for orbifolds: which orbifolds covered by compact symmetric spaces admit isospectral non-isometric quotients?

evidence.quote: Problem 7.7. Study Question 1.15 in the context of orbifolds covered by compact symmetric spaces.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a compact simply connected irreducible Riemannian symmetric space, and let a discrete group $\Gamma$ act properly discontinuously on $X$ by isometries (allowing fixed points), so that the quotient $\Gamma\backslash X$ is a Riemannian orbifold covered by $X$. Two such orbifolds are said to be isospectral if the Laplace–Beltrami operators acting on smooth functions have the same spectrum (with multiplicities), and isometric if there is a Riemannian orbifold isometry between them.

Determine which compact simply connected irreducible symmetric spaces $X$ admit a pair of isospectral but non-isometric Riemannian orbifold quotients $\Gamma_1\backslash X$ and $\Gamma_2\backslash X$. More generally, characterize, among orbifolds covered by compact symmetric spaces, those that occur in isospectral non-isometric pairs.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an open problem in the spectral geometry literature on symmetric spaces. While isospectral non-isometric orbifold lens spaces and Alexandrov-type examples have been constructed in special cases (e.g., spherical/lens orbifolds), no general classification for orbifold quotients of compact irreducible symmetric spaces appears in the literature, and the problem is explicitly stated as open.

status_evidence.title: Orbifold Lens Spaces that are Isospectral but not Isometric
status_evidence.snippet: Construction of orbifold lens spaces that are isospectral but not isometric, addressing special cases of spherical space form orbifolds.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results exist for orbifold quotients of spheres (lens orbifolds), but a general classification for orbifolds covered by compact symmetric spaces is not established.

status_evidence.title: Isospectral Alexandrov Spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Constructs isospectral non-isometric Alexandrov spaces arising as orbifold quotients of spheres.
status_evidence.claim: Related orbifold isospectrality constructions exist in specific symmetric-space settings, but the general orbifold question remains open.
